summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError (direct Exception subclass) and parse_shacl_path, which follows the seven-step workflow in the spec. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, a parametrized valid/invalid test, a non-node input test (None and a plain string), and a graph-unchanged test. Ran python -m pytest on the new test module and test/test_path.py with the shared venv: 39 passed. mypy, black, and isort are not installed in that venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. Type-ignore comments on URIRef operator lines (/, |, ~, *) are my reading of mypy behaviour and are unverified; the spec mentions only the multiplication case. Nothing was committed.
